finding: operand is a write-only parsing facade: addUnique creates an owned parameter and sets private visibility; readback is empty. Existing computed-setting readback validation checks structural type and unsettable state, not requested-value equality. Empty readback is not itself a blocker. Missing operations are Append requests and object creation in stored edit plans; text admission, journal integration and source-bound providers also remain.
